title: Fighting the COVID-19 Infodemic in Social Media: A Holistic Perspective and a Call to Arms
reasoning: The paper focuses on content moderation and the detection of misinformation, panic, and xenophobia in social media posts related to COVID-19. While it addresses 'harm to society' and includes categories for racism/xenophobia, it does not evaluate or benchmark religious themes, formal moral reasoning, or ethical frameworks within the models themselves.
